> **An Xposed module designed to customize and enhance the Nothing OS experience.** By leveraging the modern Xposed framework, this module injects deep system-level tweaks allowing you to tailor your Nothing device exactly to your liking. ## 🌐 [Source Code & Support](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/NothingTweaks)

## ✨ Features Nothing Tweaks comes packed with a variety of modifications to elevate your Nothing OS experience. _Click any section below to expand and view the available tweaks:_
🔒 Lockscreen
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Scramble PIN** | Randomizes the positions of the PIN keypad digits on every unlock attempt. | | **Hide Clock** | Hides the stock lockscreen clock and widgets (smartspace), ideal for third-party depth effect wallpapers. | | **Remove Glimpse Ads** | Disables the sponsored Glance / Glimpse magazine wallpaper on the lock screen. | | **Skip Power-Off Verification** | Allows powering off or restarting the device from the lock screen without entering your PIN/password. | | **Additional Charging Info** | Displays real-time wattage (W), current (mA), voltage (V), and battery temperature (°C) while charging. Positioned 10dp above the fingerprint/lock icon. | | **Double Tap to Sleep** | Double tap any empty area on the lockscreen to immediately turn off the screen. | | **Double Tap to Wake** | Double tap the screen while screen is off or in AOD to wake the device. |
🔊 Volume
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Volume Panel Timeout** | Customize the duration (in milliseconds) before the volume slider automatically dismisses (default: 3000 ms). |
📸 Screenshots & Screen Recording
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Allow Screenshots & Recording Everywhere** | Allows taking screenshots, screen recording, and casting in restricted apps and throughout the system, while blocking screenshot and recording detection. | | **Screenshot Serial Number** | Optionally watermarks your device serial number (`SN: `) onto captured screenshots. | | **Screen Recording Quality Clamp** | Force the built-in screen recorder to clamp at 720p or 1080p @ 60fps for smoother or lower-bandwidth recordings. |
⏰ Status Bar Clock
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Show Seconds** | Displays real-time seconds in the status bar clock. | | **Show Day of Week** | Prepends the abbreviated weekday (e.g. `Mon 10:10`) to the status bar clock. | | **Custom Text** | Appends custom text after the status bar time (up to 24 characters). |
👆 In-Display Fingerprint
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Color Scanning Dots** | Re-colors the animated scanning ripple dots around your finger during biometric authentication. | | **Random Color Every Tap** | Automatically rolls a fresh, vibrant color every time you touch the fingerprint scanner. | | **Custom Color Picker** | Choose any custom static color via a built-in color picker (when random mode is off). |
📱 Status Bar
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Status Bar Edge Padding** | Adjust left and right edge spacing of the status bar content to match your display corners. | | **Nothing Earphone Icon** | Replaces the generic Bluetooth status bar icon with the official Nothing earbud glyph whenever any Bluetooth audio device is connected. | | **Notification Icon Limit** | Set the maximum number of notification icons shown in the status bar and AOD. | | **Status Bar Brightness Slider** | Slide your finger horizontally across the status bar to smoothly adjust screen brightness. |
⚙️ Device Features
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Stepless Volume** | Unlocks continuous, granular volume adjustment levels. | | **Super Volume Boost** | Enables a higher maximum audio volume ceiling. | | **Palm Touch Sleep** | Turn off the screen by covering the display with your palm on the lockscreen. | | **Flip to Record** | Flip the phone face-down to automatically start voice recording. |
🧭 Navigation & Gestures
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Hide Nav Bar (with Circle to Search)** | Hides the navigation bar gesture pill completely while preserving all gesture navigation and Circle to Search functionality. | | **Hide Keyboard Space** | Removes the blank space beneath the keyboard and hides the navigation bar handle while typing. | | **Long Swipe Back to Kill App** | Hold the back swipe gesture and release to immediately kill and force-stop the foreground application. |
🤖 AI & Miscellaneous
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Gemini AI Clipboard Chip** | Redirects the Nothing OS clipboard AI action chip to Google Gemini instead of ChatGPT. | | **Disable Temperature Warnings** | Disables intrusive high-temperature system warning dialogs. |
🛠️ System
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Allow 180° Rotation** | Allows the screen to rotate completely upside-down (reverse portrait). | | **Advanced Power Menu** | Adds direct reboot options for Recovery and Bootloader / Fastboot to the power menu. |
## 🚀 Installation 1. Ensure your device is rooted and **[LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)** is installed. 2. Download the latest Nothing Tweaks APK from the **[Releases](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/NothingTweaks/releases/)** page and install it. 3. Open the **LSPosed Manager** app and enable the Nothing Tweaks module. 4. Reboot your device (or restart `SystemUI` and `Nothing Launcher`) to apply the changes. 5. Open the **Nothing Tweaks** app to configure your settings! ## 🤝 Credits & Acknowledgements This project would not have been possible without the amazing work of the Android modding community. Special thanks to: * **[rovo89](https://github.com/rovo89)** - For creating the original [Xposed Framework](https://github.com/rovo89/Xposed), which pioneered this level of Android customization. * **[LSPosed Team](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)** - For maintaining and advancing the modern ART hooking framework that powers this module today. * **[Rares6567](https://github.com/Rares6567)** - For _"hide space under keyboard"_ feature. And his project [NothingXpert](https://github.com/Rares6567/NothingXpert). * **[LSPosed/DisableFlagSecure](https://github.com/LSPosed/DisableFlagSecure)** - For the logic and research behind bypassing screenshot / screen recording detection.
--- *Disclaimer: This module modifies system-level components. Use it at your own risk.*

> **一个 Xpose 模块，旨在定制和增强 Nothing OS 体验。** 通过利用现代 Xpose 框架，该模块注入了深入的系统级调整，使您可以根据自己的喜好定制 Nothing 设备。 ## 🌐 [源代码和支持](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/NothingTweaks)

## ✨ 特点 Nothing Tweaks 包含各种修改，可提升您的 Nothing OS 体验。 _单击下面的任何部分以展开并查看可用的调整：_ <详情> <摘要>🔒锁屏
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **争夺 PIN** |每次解锁尝试时随机化 PIN 键盘数字的位置。 | | **隐藏时钟** |隐藏库存锁屏时钟和小部件（智能空间），非常适合第三方深度效果壁纸。 | | **删除浏览广告** |禁用锁定屏幕上赞助的 Glance / Glimpse 杂志壁纸。 | | **跳过断电验证** |允许从锁定屏幕关闭或重新启动设备，而无需输入 PIN/密码。 | | **附加充电信息** |充电时显示实时瓦数 (W)、电流 (mA)、电压 (V) 和电池温度 (°C)。位于指纹/锁定图标上方 10dp 处。 | | **双击睡眠** |双击锁屏上的任意空白区域可立即关闭屏幕。 | | **双击唤醒** |屏幕关闭或处于 AOD 状态时双击屏幕可唤醒设备。 | <详情> <摘要>🔊体积
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **音量面板超时** |自定义音量滑块自动关闭之前的持续时间（以毫秒为单位）（默认值：3000 毫秒）。 | <详情> 📸 屏幕截图和屏幕录制
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **允许随处截图和录制** |允许在受限制的应用程序和整个系统中进行屏幕截图、屏幕录制和投射，同时阻止屏幕截图和录制检测。 | | **屏幕截图序列号** | （可选）将您的设备序列号（“SN：<序列>”）添加到捕获的屏幕截图上。 | | **屏幕录制质量限制** |强制内置屏幕录像机固定在 720p 或 1080p @ 60fps，以实现更流畅或更低带宽的录制。 | <详情> ⏰状态栏时钟
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **显示秒** |在状态栏时钟中显示实时秒数。 | | **显示星期几** |将缩写的工作日（例如“周一 10:10”）添加到状态栏时钟。 | | **自定义文本** |在状态栏时间后附加自定义文本（最多 24 个字符）。 | <详情> 👆 屏内指纹
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **彩色扫描点** |在生物识别身份验证过程中，对手指周围的动画扫描波纹点重新着色。 | | **每次点击随机颜色** |每次触摸指纹扫描仪时，都会自动滚动一种清新、鲜艳的颜色。 | | **自定义颜色选择器** |通过内置颜色选择器选择任何自定义静态颜色（当随机模式关闭时）。 | <详情> 📱状态栏
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **状态栏边缘填充** |调整状态栏内容的左右边缘间距以匹配显示角。 | | **没有耳机图标** |取代通用蓝牙每当连接任何蓝牙音频设备时，带有官方 Nothing 耳塞字形的 tatus 栏图标。 | | **通知图标限制** |设置状态栏和 AOD 中显示的通知图标的最大数量。 | | **状态栏亮度滑块** |在状态栏上水平滑动手指可平滑调节屏幕亮度。 | <详情> ⚙️设备功能
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **无级音量** |解锁连续、精细的音量调整级别。 | | **超级音量提升** |启用更高的最大音频音量上限。 | | **手掌触摸睡眠** |将手掌放在锁定屏幕上覆盖显示屏即可关闭屏幕。 | | **翻转录制** |将手机正面朝下翻转即可自动开始录音。 | <详情> 🧭 导航和手势
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **隐藏导航栏（带圆圈进行搜索）** |完全隐藏导航栏手势药丸，同时保留所有手势导航和圆圈搜索功能。 | | **隐藏键盘空间** |删除键盘下方的空白区域并在键入时隐藏导航栏手柄。 | | **长滑返回杀死应用程序** |按住向后滑动手势并松开可立即终止并强制停止前台应用程序。 | <详情> 🤖 人工智能与其他
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **Gemini AI 剪贴板芯片** |将 Nothing OS 剪贴板 AI 操作芯片重定向到 Google Gemini，而不是 ChatGPT。 | | **禁用温度警告** |禁用侵入式高温系统警告对话框。 | <详情> 🛠️系统
|特色 |描述 | | :--- | :--- | | **允许 180° 旋转** |允许屏幕完全上下旋转（反向纵向）。 | | **高级电源菜单** |将恢复和引导加载程序/快速启动的直接重新启动选项添加到电源菜单。 | ## 🚀 安装 1. 确保您的设备已取得 root 权限并且已安装 **[LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)**。 2. 从 **[Releases](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/NothingTweaks/releases/)** 页面下载最新的 Nothing Tweaks APK 并安装。 3. 打开 **LSPosed Manager** 应用程序并启用 Nothing Tweaks 模块。 4. 重新启动您的设备（或重新启动 `SystemUI` 和 `Nothing Launcher`）以应用更改。 5. 打开 **Nothing Tweaks** 应用程序来配置您的设置！ ## 🤝 致谢与致谢 如果没有 Android 改装社区的出色工作，这个项目就不可能实现。特别感谢： * **[rovo89](https://github.com/rovo89)** - 用于创建原始的 [Xposed Framework](https://github.com/rovo89/Xposed)，它开创了这种级别的 Android 定制。 * **[LSPosed Team](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)** - 用于维护和推进当今为该模块提供支持的现代 ART 挂钩框架。 * **[Rares6567](https://github.com/Rares6567)** - 用于_“隐藏键盘下的空间”_功能。以及他的项目 [NothingXpert](https://github.com/Rares6567/NothingXpert)。 * **[LSPosed/DisableFlagSecure](https://github.com/LSPosed/DisableFlagSecure)** - 用于绕过屏幕截图/屏幕录制检测背后的逻辑和研究。
--- *免责声明：该模块修改系统级组件。使用它需要您自担风险。*
